original_question: Mark yɛ nsɛmni ho kyerɛwfoɔ. Ɔkyerɛ nsɛmfua dodoɔ baako wɔ nnawɔtwe biara ma dea ɔtintim nnwoma mmienu a deɛ ɛda nso wɔn mu biara tua no ka soronko wɔ asɛmfua biara ho. Mark nya sika ahe wɔ nnawɔtwe biara, wɔ cent mu?
